content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Multiple kube OOMKills and pod evictions in cluster gpu-serve-prod (ephemeral storage pressure) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Severity: SEV-2 — customer-visible errors reported. Trigger: node filesystem utilization > 95% and kubelet eviction events.

3500001234 incident-bot: Initial detections: 12 pods evicted in last 5m, several runtime pods restarted, 4 CUDA init failures noted.

Dinesh (oncall): I'm on it. Starting triage. Which node set?

Carmen (infra): Observed on nodes node-12, node-16, node-21 (all `gpu.large`). Profiles show modelcache and runtime pods taking large /tmp and /var/log usage.

Alice (eng-runtime): Confirming: modelcache pods write large unpacked checkpoints to /var/tmp/modelcache when cache misses spike. Logs grew quickly. Also saw `cudaInit` errors on some restarts — likely because pod restarts raced with eviction.

Ben (eng-sre): Customer impact? Any 5xx/latency spike on API?

Eve (support): CS reports multiple customers seeing 502s and degraded prompt latency ~10m ago. At least two enterprise customers opened tickets (acct-redwood-42, acct-nimbus).

customer-success-bot: Notifying CS leads: please check https://incidents.internal/r/3500001234/status

Dinesh (oncall): Quick plan: 1) identify worst nodes and cordon; 2) reduce log verbosity / purge old rotated logs; 3) scale down modelcache hot paths; 4) restart kubelet if necessary; 5) run temporary model-serving fallback (lower-memory quantized model) to keep endpoints up.

Carmen (infra): I'll cordon node-12 and node-16 now. Please avoid mass restarts of large pods — use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` only for controlled drains.

infra-bot: Runbook step: check eviction events:
```
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Evicted -A --since=10m
kubectl describe node node-12 | egrep -i "evict|Pressure"
```

infra-bot: Sample eviction event (truncated):
```
Type    Reason   Age   From     Message
Normal  Evicted  3m    kubelet  Pod "modelcache-7f8d" was evicted: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
```

Alice (eng-runtime): Attaching a quick diagnostic snippet from the pod that crashed:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] runtime ERROR: failed to allocate KV cache: write /var/tmp/modelcache/checkpoint.tmp: no space left on device
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] runtime WARN: cuda: failed init on retry 2: out of memory
```

Dinesh (oncall): Carmen, cordon done for node-12 and node-16. node-21 looks borderline but not cordoned yet.

Carmen (infra): Acknowledged. Starting log rotation/purge on those nodes (old rotated logs >7d). Will also drop /var/log/journal older than 3d.

Alice (eng-runtime): To avoid future unpack thrash, I'm going to change the modelcache unpacker to stream-only mode for large checkpoints (will avoid full unpack to /var/tmp). Pushing a hotpatch to canary pool.

Ben (eng-sre): While that lands, we should reduce retention on the modelcache container logs and enable `emptyDir` size limits. Adding a temporary limit to the daemonset spec: `emptyDir: { sizeLimit: "10Gi" }` for modelcache.

Eve (support): Noted customer impact: 502s spiking around 10:07-10:20, currently tapering but still abnormal for some routes. Communicating to CS to message customers with ETA ~30m.

infra-bot: Disk usage snapshot (node-12):
```
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme0n1p1  1.8T  1.7T  20G  99% /
tmpfs           128G  8G   120G   7% /run
/var/tmp/modelcache   500G  470G 30G  94% /var/tmp/modelcache
```

Dinesh (oncall): Next actions: - Avoid full redeploys. - Scale up dedicated pool `gpu-burst` (2 nodes) to take traffic that needs large modelcache. - Failover heavy customers to quantized fallback. Carmen, can you spin ephemeral nodes in us-west-2b?

Carmen (infra): Starting `gpu-burst` autoscale now (requesting 2 nodes, approx 8m to join).

Alice (eng-runtime): Pushing canary for streaming unpack patch to 3 pods in `modelcache-canary` (eviction risk much lower). If stable, promote. Also enabling KV-cache aggressive pruning for LRU < 30m.

Ben (eng-sre): I'm applying the `emptyDir` sizeLimit change to the StatefulSet (rolling patch with maxUnavailable=1).

infra-bot: Action log:
- 3500001250: cordoned node-12, node-16
- 3500001280: purged rotated logs >7d on node-12
- 3500001320: started gpu-burst autoscale request
- 3500001380: applied emptyDir sizeLimit to modelcache sts

Dinesh (oncall): Observability: token-level latency for /generate reduced from 1.8s -> 1.1s for canary path, but legacy endpoints still 502 for some requests. Need more traffic shifted.

Eve (support): CS updated customers with interim mitigation and link to status page. No escalations to legal yet.

Alice (eng-runtime): Canary looks good for 12m. No evictions on canary pods. I'm promoting to canary -> prod with 2-minute staggered rollout.

Carmen (infra): gpu-burst nodes joined (approx +2 nodes). Rebalancing scheduler taking place.

Ben (eng-sre): Post-patch metrics: eviction rate down 90% in last 10m. CUDA init failures dropped.

Dinesh (oncall): Great. Next: run post-incident cleanup playbook and add follow-ups:
- Add model unpack streaming by default for > 4GB artifacts
- Add emptyDir size limits to modelcache daemonset permanently
- Improve log rotation to aggressive rotation for /var/log/journal on GPU nodes
- Add alert for ephemeral storage usage > 85% with 5m window

Eve (support): ETA for full customer restoration?

Dinesh (oncall): Expect full restoration in ~20-30m as rebalanced pods warm caches. Keeping page open.

customer-success-bot: CS notified customers of mitigation.

Ben (eng-sre): Kubelet eviction TTLs and imagefs thresholds reviewed. Proposing increasing `eviction-hard` ephemeral-storage threshold from 85% -> 90% temporarily (requires careful ops approval).

Carmen (infra): Will not change thresholds without approvals. Instead recommending healthier housekeeping and autoscale policies.

Dinesh (oncall): Handing off to Ben for the post-mortem and follow-up action items. I'm unassigning oncall in 10m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Ben (eng-sre): Taking ownership for the postmortem. I'll create the doc and link to runbook with relevant logs.

3500004321 incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Degraded -> Mitigated. Monitoring for residual errors.
